description: Twenty shillings, and the speed of a pen

participation.context: Paid the twenty shillings, refused the contest, and would not name a successor.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Counted the rent twice, showed the notch, and named sixpence without taking it.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Brought the sheet from the stall to the hall, and asked if he would enter.
participation.name: Michael Drayton

story.body: You heard the contest from Drayton and declined it on any judge but speed. You paid twenty shillings, stood for the silver told twice, and heard the sixpence named without handing it over. You let the short loaf stand as its own remark. You did not guess the next Mayor.

title: Paid twenty shillings

relations.note: the sixpence is a rate, and it is not on this page as paid

story.body: You counted the coffer and ruled £23 10s. You did not open the canvas. You did not add the shares. You did not collect Quiney, and you did not write what would be left if the sixty went.

relations.note: the sixpence is a rate, and it is not on this page as paid
